# vbeat_audio synth API (generated by `python -m vbeat_audio docs`; do not edit by hand)

Cue script: `from synth import *`, define `render(ctx)`, return a mono float array (normally `m.render()`).
Times are seconds, frequencies Hz, levels dB. Sounds are float32 mono, SR=48000, deterministic (seeded).
Recipes peak at 0.5 and last 1.2 s or less. Levels: accent gain_db 0, ordinary -4, soft detail -9.
Imports allowed: numpy, scipy (signal, ndimage, fft), math, functools, itertools, collections, dataclasses,
typing, synth. Refused: open/exec/eval, __dunder__ access, numpy.random and random (use ctx.rng), file I/O,
str.format (use f-strings). Do not iterate a set of strings (random order); use sorted().
Beat-local fields: ctx.sr ctx.fps ctx.samples ctx.dur ctx.words[{id,start,end}] ctx.markers[{id,t,kind}].

## ctx
ctx.at(word_id, edge='start', offset=0.0)
    Time in seconds of a word edge ('start' or 'end') plus offset (default 0.0 s).
ctx.marker(marker_id)
    Time in seconds of the engine marker with this id.
ctx.marker_times(kind)
    Sorted list of marker times (seconds) of one kind, e.g. 'pop'.
ctx.rng(label=0)
    Deterministic numpy Generator derived from the spec seed and a label (int or str).
ctx.mix()
    New Mix bound to this beat (renders exactly ctx.samples samples).

## Mix (m = ctx.mix())
m.add(t, x, gain_db=0.0, name=None, anchor=None, align='start')
    Place sound x so it starts at t seconds (align 'start'), its loudest moment lands at t ('peak')
    or it ends at t ('end'). gain_db in dB (0.0). name and anchor (a marker or word id) are logged.
m.add_group(name, items, gain_db=0.0, anchor=None, align='start')
    Place several sounds [(t, x), ...] and log them as ONE texture cue (a run of ticks). gain_db
    (0.0).
m.render()
    Return the mixed float32 array of exactly ctx.samples samples.

## low level
osc(kind, freq_hz, dur, phase=0.0)
    Oscillator: kind sine|tri|saw|square, freq_hz (Hz, number or per-sample array), dur (s), phase
    (rad, 0).
noise(kind, dur, seed=0)
    Noise: kind white|pink|brown, dur (s), seed (int, 0). RMS is about 0.25, peak below 1.
env_adsr(dur, attack=0.01, decay=0.05, sustain=0.7, release=0.1)
    Linear ADSR envelope over dur (s): attack, decay, release in s (0.01, 0.05, 0.1), sustain level
    0..1 (0.7).
env_exp(dur, tau)
    Exponential decay envelope exp(-t/tau) from 1.0: dur (s), tau (s, time constant).
env_perc(dur, attack=0.003, tau=0.05)
    Percussive envelope: raised-cosine attack (s, 0.003) to 1.0, then exp decay with tau (s, 0.05).
sweep(f0, f1, dur, curve='exp')
    Per-sample frequency trajectory in Hz from f0 to f1 over dur (s); curve
    exp|linear|ease_in|ease_out|smooth.
lowpass(x, fc, order=2)
    Butterworth low-pass: x, cutoff fc (Hz), order (2). Causal sos filter.
highpass(x, fc, order=2)
    Butterworth high-pass: x, cutoff fc (Hz), order (2). Causal sos filter.
bandpass(x, band, order=2)
    Butterworth band-pass: band is (lo_hz, hi_hz) or one centre in Hz (then one octave wide); order
    (2).
bandpass_sweep(x, centers, q=1.5, order=2, n_bands=12)
    Band-pass whose centre moves over time: x, centers (Hz per sample or one value), q (1.5), order
    (2).
resonator(x, freq, decay)
    Two-pole resonator: x, freq (Hz), decay (s, amplitude time constant). Unity gain at the
    resonance.
modal(freqs, decays, amps, dur, excite=None)
    Modal synthesis: sum of decaying sines. freqs (Hz), decays (s, time constants), amps (linear),
    dur (s).
echo(x, delay, feedback=0.3, mix=0.3, tail=0.6)
    Feedback echo: delay (s), feedback 0..0.9 (0.3), mix = level of the first repeat vs dry 0..1
    (0.3).
small_room(x, size=0.5, mix=0.2, seed=0)
    Tiny room: size 0..1 (0.5), mix = wet level vs dry 0..1 (0.2). Reverb tail capped at 0.25 s.
soft_clip(x, drive=2.0)
    Tanh saturation: drive >0 (2.0); output is scaled so an input of +-1 stays +-1.
fade(x, in_ms=0.0, out_ms=0.0, curve='linear')
    Fade in and out: in_ms, out_ms (milliseconds, 0), curve linear|cos.
gain_db(x, db)
    Scale by db decibels (negative is quieter).
peak_normalize(x, peak=0.5)
    Scale so the maximum absolute sample equals peak (linear, 0.5); silence stays silence.
concat(parts, gap=0.0)
    Join arrays one after another with gap seconds (0.0) of silence between them.
overlay(parts, offsets=None)
    Sum arrays; offsets are start times in seconds per part (default all 0). Length = longest end.
silence(dur)
    Zeros for dur seconds.
tick_times(t0, t1, n, curve='linear')
    n event times (s) from t0 to t1 inclusive. curve linear | ease_in (gaps shrink, ticks
    accelerate) | ease_out (gaps grow, ticks settle).

## recipes
paper_slide(dur=0.35, bright=0.5, seed=0)
    Dry paper slide 'fff': pink noise, band centre sweeping 1 to 5 kHz (x bright), dur 0.35 s,
    bright 0..1.
paper_flick(dur=0.12, seed=0)
    Card snap: noise 2 to 9 kHz, 1 ms attack, about 40 ms decay, dur 0.12 s.
page_turn(dur=0.5, seed=0)
    Page turn: soft noise sweep 800 to 3000 Hz, then a small flap thump near 120 Hz at the end; dur
    0.5 s.
pen_tick(pitch=1800.0, seed=0)
    Felt-tip tick: modes at 1x, 1.6x, 2.4x of pitch (Hz, 1800), decays 15 to 40 ms, 2 ms noise; 70
    ms total.
pen_scribble(dur=0.5, seed=0)
    Pen scribble: noise 3 to 7 kHz, amplitude-modulated 14 to 20 Hz (seeded), dur 0.5 s.
soft_pop(pitch=420.0, seed=0)
    Soft pop: sine falling 1.35x to 1x pitch (Hz, 420) over 40 ms, 3 ms attack, tau 45 ms, 3 kHz
    lowpass; 150 ms.
bubble_pop(pitch=700.0, seed=0)
    Bubble pop: 60 ms micro chirp rising then falling around pitch (Hz, 700), fast attack, quick
    decay.
wood_thunk(pitch=140.0, size=1.0, seed=0)
    Wood thunk: modes 1x, 2.3x, 3.7x of pitch (Hz, 140), decays 120/70/40 ms x size^0.5, 5 ms thump;
    <=350 ms.
stamp(weight=1.0, seed=0)
    Rubber stamp: wood_thunk at 90 to 140 Hz (lower when weight is higher) plus a 1.5 kHz ink slap,
    60 ms; <=400 ms.
swoosh(dur=0.4, direction='up', bright=0.5, seed=0)
    Swoosh: band-passed noise, centre 400 to 3500 Hz (x bright 0..1) rising ('up') or falling
    ('down'); peak at 60%.
click(soft=0.5, seed=0)
    UI click: 2 ms noise plus a 2.2 kHz sine with 15 ms decay, soft 0..1 (0.5; higher is rounder);
    60 ms.
chime(pitch=880.0, seed=0)
    Small bell: bar-mode partials at 1x, 2.756x, 5.404x of pitch (Hz, 880), decays 600/250/120 ms;
    0.8 s.
cloth_rustle(dur=0.5, seed=0)
    Cloth rustle: noise low-passed near 1.5 kHz with seeded amplitude flutter at 8 to 25 Hz, dur 0.5
    s.
type_keys(n=6, rate=9.0, seed=0)
    Typing run: n key clicks (6) with a 200 Hz thock at rate keys per second (9), jitter <=25 ms.
type_key_events(n=6, rate=9.0, seed=0)
    Key presses as [(offset_s, array), ...] for Mix.add_group: n keys (6), rate keys/s (9), jitter
    <=25 ms.
coin_clink(pitch=2600.0, seed=0)
    Ceramic coin clink: two pings 70 ms apart, partials 1x, 1.6x, 2.3x of pitch (Hz, 2600), decays
    150 ms.
footstep_soft(surface='dirt', seed=0)
    Soft footstep: low thump plus filtered noise on surface dirt|wood|paper, 120 to 150 ms.
